x-inspectra.cliParsedDescription: sqlfactory — Schema migration and cross-engine data copy CLI for SqlFactory.

options.name: --connection
options.description: Database connection string. Env: SQLFACTORY_CONNECTION.

options.name: --provider
options.description: Provider invariant name (e.g. Microsoft.Data.Sqlite, Npgsql, MySqlConnector, Microsoft.Data.SqlClient). Auto-detected from connection string when omitted. Env: SQLFACTORY_PROVIDER.

options.name: --connection-from-keychain
options.description: macOS Keychain service name. Reads connection string from Keychain (never logged, Rule 1/3a). Takes precedence over --connection and env var.

options.name: --assembly
options.description: Path to the DLL containing IMigration classes. Omit to scan the current working directory for *.dll files.

options.name: --quiet
options.description: Suppress all output except errors.

options.name: --verbose
options.description: Emit detailed diagnostic output to stderr.

options.name: --no-color
options.description: Disable ANSI color output. Automatically set when NO_COLOR env var is present.

options.name: --lock-timeout
options.description: Migration advisory lock timeout in seconds. Default: 300.

options.name: --version
options.description: Show version information

options.name: -h
options.description: Show help and usage information

options.name: --target
options.description: Apply migrations up to and including this version. Omit to apply all pending.

options.name: --dry-run
options.description: Preview SQL without applying (alias for 'migrate preview').

commands.name: down
commands.description: Roll back applied schema migrations to a target version.

options.name: --target
options.description: Target version to roll back to (inclusive). Use 0 to roll back all migrations.

options.name: --confirm
options.description: Skip the interactive Y/N confirmation prompt.

commands.name: preview
commands.description: Show the SQL that would run for pending migrations (no database changes).

options.name: --all
options.description: Preview all migrations, not just pending ones.

commands.name: baseline
commands.description: Mark the schema as already at a specific version without running migrations. Useful when adopting SqlFactory on an existing database.

options.name: --version
options.description: The schema version to mark as applied.

options.name: --description
options.description: Human-readable description recorded in __schema_migrations.

options.name: --confirm
options.description: Skip the interactive Y/N confirmation prompt.

commands.name: cross-engine
commands.description: Copy all table data from a source database to a target database across engine types.

options.name: --source-connection
options.description: Source database connection string.

options.name: --source-provider
options.description: Source database provider (auto-detected if omitted).

options.name: --source-from-keychain
options.description: Read source connection string from macOS Keychain service (masked, Rule 1/3a).

options.name: --target-connection
options.description: Target database connection string.

options.name: --target-provider
options.description: Target database provider (auto-detected if omitted).

options.name: --target-from-keychain
options.description: Read target connection string from macOS Keychain service (masked, Rule 1/3a).

options.name: --batch
options.description: Number of rows per batch.

options.name: --verify
options.description: Validation type after copy: 'count' (default) or 'checksum'.

options.name: --checkpoint
options.description: Enable checkpoint/resume for interrupted migrations.

options.name: --workers
options.description: Number of parallel worker threads (currently 1; multi-table parallelism is Phase 3).

options.name: --tables
options.description: Comma-separated list of tables to migrate. Omit to migrate all tables.

options.name: --disable-fk
options.description: Disable FK checks for all tables during copy (default: only for cycle tables).

commands.name: license
commands.description: License management: view status, activate, deactivate, or start a free trial.

commands.name: status
commands.description: Show the current license state, mode, and trial availability.

arguments.name: LICENSEFILEPATH
arguments.description: Path to a SqlFactory license file (.pem) to install.

commands.name: deactivate
commands.description: Removes the license installed via 'license activate'. Manually placed license files (in the working directory or application base directory) are outside this command's scope and must be removed manually.

options.name: --confirm
options.description: Skip the interactive Y/N confirmation prompt.

commands.name: trial
commands.description: Start a free, 100%-offline 7-day fully-functional Enterprise trial (once per machine).
